text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki shone brightly with a 
1st-place finish in the Kikuka Sho. The 
crowd went wild and raised their 
expectations even higher for the girl who 
overcame the distance barrier to conquer 
the long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Fuji Kiseki suggested to her 
Trainer that she run in the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen next. A 1200m turf 
sprint GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer is puzzled by the sudden 
change in distance. However, Fuji Kiseki 
seems to have something in mind.
